about: B126: the Spanish set for the site templates, the /admin shell and the collections' pages. Each pair is an exact piece of an English template file and the Spanish that replaces it when a site is made with `site new --lang es`, switched with `site lang NAME es`, or stamped locally with `site render TYPE DIR --lang es` (lib/site_lang.py does the pass). The English files stay the only source; a pair whose English is no longer in any template is stale and `site doctor` says so (tests/test_site_lang.py too). Keys carry their markup (`<label>Name <input`) so a short word never lands inside code; no Spanish piece may hold an English key or be shared by two English ones, so the pass is idempotent and `site lang NAME en` goes back exactly. Usted throughout: a business writing to a customer it hasn't met. `complete` lists the templates whose built-in lines are all here (the REPLACE-ME placeholders are Patch's to write).
